qs.q: A 45-year-old woman with a functioning adrenal tumour undergoes successful surgical resection. In the immediate post-operative recovery period, what metabolic complication must clinicians monitor for alongside hypotension?
o: Severe rebound hyperinsulinaemia leading to hypoglycaemia
Profound hyperkalaemia secondary to mineralocorticoid excess
Acute hypocalcaemia resulting from parathyroid gland suppression
Uncontrolled diabetic ketoacidosis from acute insulin deficiency
qs.e: Post-operative monitoring after phaeochromocytoma resection must include vigilance for hypoglycaemia resulting from rebound hyperinsulinaemia after the inhibitory effect of catecholamines is removed. Hyperkalaemia is not a standard rebound feature of catecholamine withdrawal.
